g.text: +setPattern(image, pick, angle, w, h, dist, boxAngle, showBoxes)
The ONE implementation of the pick marker, the X/Y
orientation gizmo and the jaw pair. Shared so the
authoring canvas and the read-only thumbnail cannot
drift apart -- "drawn the same way" decays silently
with two copies, and this gizmo was revised twice
Takes widget (viewport) pixels only: callers do their
own image-to-widget mapping, so it knows nothing about
zoom, pan or crop. Gizmo sizes are widget-pixel
constants (fixed on screen); jaw boxes arrive
Operator runtime shell (Phase 6). Reuses the dashboard
widget as-is and deliberately NOT LocalizationTaskWidget,
which starts Commission on the task in its constructor.
Peer of MainWindow, not a child: neither shell may
include the other's headers. Only MainWindow writes a
Viewer, not editor: pan / zoom / reset only.
Read-only by CONSTRUCTION -- one pixmap item with no
interaction flags and no accepted mouse buttons, plus
ScrollHandDrag -- rather than by disabling handlers
Overlay is drawn in drawForeground() with the world
transform reset, which is what keeps the gizmo a
constant on-screen size while the jaw boxes stay locked
to the image. Needs FullViewportUpdate: the overlay
lives outside scene coordinates, so a partial repaint
would clip it against the wrong rectangle.
Robot card is not implemented in the wizard.
Unsupported families or sub-types return nullptr.
A40 uses explicit PLC tag capabilities
instead of assuming every device exposes
Per-camera workspace (ROI) is edited via CameraWorkspaceWidget +
WorkspaceSettingDialog and stored in TaskLocalizeConfig (keyed by
camera id; reference image as a project_images BLOB).
LocalizationPatternsWidget shows the active camera's ROI overlay and
crops the commission test image by the working ROI. LocalizationPipeline
also applies the condition ROI through ImageMatcher::setMatchingConditionROI();
cropOffsetPoint maps match results back to the matcher input frame.
A50 displays explicit task state in the task header.
READY lamp now reflects TaskState rather than
Dashboard v1 is a read-only operator runtime page.
It shows assigned devices, active camera/pattern group,
fault code, signal monitor, last match image, KPIs,
result table, and a bounded task-local log monitor.
It does not expose start/stop/reset/manual trigger controls.
